text:
marie: FYI kicking off POC with Aurum Health today. They want to run a tuned Llama-2 variant in our Dedicated env. Need model onboarding checklist + any enterprise blockers (KMS, quant, pricing).

alex: copying checklist: model checksum, config, quantization artifacts, sample prompts, eval set. quick q — are they shipping a 13B or 30B variant?

jordan: (Aurum) we'll start with a 13B fine-tune, may push to a 30B later. Latency SLO: tail < 250ms for single-turn queries, throughput ~200 rps.

marie: noted. Also they asked about KV cache compatibility — conversation with infra needed.

sam: KV cache should be fine on Dedicated but depends on sequence length distribution and batch sizing. If they use long context (>=8k) we need to map to larger KV shards. Can you ask for prompt length histogram?

jordan: sending hist now, short and mid mostly: 512 median, 1k 95th. occasional 4k.

alex: good. we should recommend prefix caching + per-customer cache namespace. For the 4k tails we may need to disable batching or route those to a high-memory pool.

marie: security question: they require KMS/HSM-backed key handling and an audit trail for model artifacts. Tanya, any blockers?

tanya: KMS integration ok for Private and Dedicated if they use our BYOK workflow. Audit logs — we can provide object-level write/read logs to SIEM. Need contract clause for key escrow?

jordan: Aurum prefers customer-managed keys (BYOK) and no key escrow. They need assurances on key rotation and zero-access from provider.

tanya: BYOK + HSM = supported. We'll need a short security questionnaire answered and a list of artifact access principals. I can draft the response.

alex: model format — they will provide a fused checkpoint + tokenizer. We need:
```
- model.safetensors
- tokenizer.json
- model-config.json (architecture, hidden_size, kv-layers)
- optional quantization.bin
```
If they send a 4bit quant, we'll run a compatibility pass.

marie: pricing — they asked about unit pricing for quantized vs fp16. Is there a delta we can quote for Dedicated?

sam: for Dedicated we price on capacity + token multiplier. Rough rule: q4_0 ~ 0.6x cost, q8 ~ 0.75x, fp16 ~ 1.0x. Those are starting points; final pricing depends on throughput and reserved commit.

marie: can we lock a discounted commit if they sign a 12mo reserved capacity? Jordan, what's their runway?

jordan: likely 12 months, starting small (SLA + burst). Need an initial POC for 6 weeks to validate.

alex: POC plan proposal:
1) Onboard model artifacts to staging (1-2 days)
2) Compatibility & quant check (2-3 days)
3) Performance tuning (batching, KV namespaces) (1 week)
4) Production smoke + security review (1 week)
5) Billing contract & Reserved capacity negotiation (ongoing)
Please confirm.

marie: looks good. Action items: Jordan to upload artifacts + prompt histogram (they said they'd send). Alex to run compatibility pass and post results. Sam to pre-check Dedicated pool capacity and HSM onboarding steps. Tanya to draft security questionnaire responses. I'll coordinate pricing with finance.

jordan: uploading artifacts now (link to S3). I'll ping when it's live. Thanks.

deploy-bot: resource-request created #req-8591 for dedicated-pool-precheck (owner: sam).

sam: saw the upload. Starting compatibility check. Quick heads up: if the provided quant file uses a custom scale layout we'll need to re-quantize which adds 1-2 days.

alex: running local dry-run inference on the checkpoint; initial logits look stable. Posting small snippet of the validation command:
```
python infra/validate_model.py --model s3://aurum/artifacts/model.safetensors --tokenizer s3://aurum/artifacts/tokenizer.json --eval sample_eval.json
```
Result: perplexity ~2.1 on eval set, no mismatched dims.

marie: great. Jordan — if we pass compatibility we can start the 6-week POC next week. Any contractual NDAs or entitlements we should know about?

jordan: NDA signed yesterday. They'll want SOC2 + custom DPA in the contract. Also a clause for customer-managed key responsibilities.

tanya: we'll include SOC2 attestation and DPA template. For BYOK: operations will not have access to unencrypted keys; we'll document rotation procedures.

marie: ok. I'll spin a one-pager pricing estimate based on q4 and fp16 deltas + reserved commit options and post here.

alex: one more engineering note — request that they avoid using fused custom ops in the checkpoint. Those are the usual incompatibility footguns. If they need them, we must build custom kernels.

jordan: noted — will verify with the training team. Thanks everyone.

marie: follow-ups: alex post compatibility checklist link, sam confirm dedicated pool sizing, tanya upload security draft. tagging @sam and @tanya for visibility. :thumbsup:
